snippet.title: Figments - Official Main Theme Reveal Trailer
snippet.description: Introducing the Figments OST Main Theme! This is the second trailer for the indie video game, Figments, a game made by two composers. Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2923880/Figments/
